thor halvorssen: The 2023 FDA decision rejecting MDMA for PTSD was devastating, not just for Rick and MAPS, but for the broader movement for legalization and therapeutic access. What happened there exposed how fear, stigma, and institutional cowardice can still derail life-changing science. The human cost of that failure is profound, and I'm glad this film will face it directly and honestly. This story matters, Rick's work matters, and the reckoning this film documents is an important one.
sarena snider: I believe psychedelic-assisted therapy holds real promise for people living with complex PTSD and trauma. That possibility exists today largely because of Rick Doblin, who spent decades pushing for rigorous research when almost no one else would. He had the vision.
